Requirement: US-6.3, US-8.1, CLAUDE.md "no AI output reaches committee without a review gate"
Title: Readiness gate passes vacuously - an assessment with nothing mapped, reviewed or scored can be finalized and routed to committee
Expected: Readiness requires at least one mapped category, a reviewed narrative and a score per category; finalize/route are refused otherwise.
Actual: GET /Readiness returns isReady=true for a brand-new assessment with zero categories; Finalize and Route both return 200 and the item appears in the committee queue. The UI Finalize tab says "Ready to finalize." with the button enabled.
Probable root cause: AssessmentService.CheckReadinessAsync only loops over active categories - with none, both outstanding lists are empty so IsReady is true.
Suggested fix: Treat "no active categories" (and "category without a score") as outstanding items; add a DB-level check in func_finalizeAssessment as well.

Title: No server-side role enforcement; acting user is taken from the request body
Expected: 403 for actions outside the caller's role; the actor is derived from the authenticated token, never from the payload.
Actual: A Product Owner id is accepted as committeeMemberUserId (vote recorded and counted toward quorum -> decision "Deferred"), as the finalizing analyst, and as the author of a scoring-config change. Menu hiding is the only role restriction.
Probable root cause: Controllers accept ActorUserId / CommitteeMemberUserId / DecidedByUserId in DTOs and have no role/policy checks ([Authorize] only).
Suggested fix: Resolve the user from the JWT subject, add role policies per endpoint, and validate committee membership before counting a vote.

Title: Deployed Container App runs in Development mode with the auth bypass active
Expected: Auth0 JWT validation on the public URL; OpenAPI and dev bypass disabled outside local dev.
Actual: Every API answers anonymous callers (user e-mails, all requests, config); a forged "alg:none" bearer token is accepted; /openapi/v1.json publishes all 45 routes; the SPA offers "Continue without signing in (local dev only)".
Probable root cause: Container App has ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development and AUTH0_DOMAIN unset, so Program.cs registers DevBypassAuthHandler and MapOpenApi; the SPA was built without VITE_AUTH0_* values.
Suggested fix: Set ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production (or Staging) plus AUTH0_DOMAIN/AUTH0_AUDIENCE on the Container App; build the SPA with the Auth0 env vars; restrict ingress until then.

Title: CORS reflects any Origin
Expected: Only the deployed webapp origin is allowed (the SPA is same-origin, so none is needed at all).
Actual: GET and pre-flight requests from Origin https://evil.example receive Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://evil.example.
Probable root cause: Likely an allow-all CORS policy on the Container App ingress or a wildcard CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS value (ops/README documents localhost only).
Suggested fix: Remove the ingress CORS policy / set CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS to the app's own origin.

Title: A committee member's vote is silently overwritten when they vote again
Expected: Re-vote rejected (409), or a new versioned vote row with the original kept.
Actual: Second vote by the same member returns 200 with the SAME vote id; the votes table now shows only the new vote (Approve -> Reject).
Probable root cause: func_castCommitteeVote uses ON CONFLICT (assessment_id, committee_member_user_id) DO UPDATE.
Suggested fix: Insert-only votes (reject duplicates) or append a new version and keep history; audit before/after.

Title: API accepts blank conditions / whitespace-only rationale
Expected: 400 - conditions / rationale must contain text.
Actual: ApproveWithConditions with conditionsText "" -> 200; Defer with rationale "   " -> 200. Only the UI validates.
Probable root cause: CHECK constraints test only IS NOT NULL; service does not trim/validate.
Suggested fix: Validate non-blank (trimmed) in CommitteeService and tighten the CHECK to length(trim(x)) > 0.

Title: Finalized assessment is not locked - narrative, score and category edits still succeed
Expected: Writes to a Finalized assessment rejected (409) and controls disabled in the UI.
Actual: After Finalize (and even after routing), Narrative/Edit, Scoring/Override and CategoryMapping/Override all return 200; UI keeps every editing control enabled.
Probable root cause: No status guard in the Narrative / Scoring / CategoryMapping services or their stored functions.
Suggested fix: Guard every write path on assessment.status <> Finalized (DB function + service) and disable controls in AssessmentWorkspace.jsx.

Title: Replacing a document (new version) always fails with HTTP 500
Expected: Version 2 created; version 1 retained and marked superseded.
Actual: AttachDocumentFile and AttachDocument with supersedesAttachmentId both return 500 "Failed to attach document."; only version 1 rows can ever be created.
Probable root cause: Probable: func_attachDocument RETURNS TABLE (id, version_number), whose OUT columns shadow the table columns, making "UPDATE change_request_attachment ... WHERE id = ..." ambiguous in PL/pgSQL.
Suggested fix: Qualify the columns (a.id) or rename the OUT params; add a test for the replacement path.

Title: UI "Extract with AI" sends the file NAME as the document text - nothing is extracted
Expected: Extraction runs on the server-side extracted text of the attachment.
Actual: Clicking Extract with AI on vendor-due-diligence.pdf shows "Extraction complete" but "Nothing extracted yet."; the same document text sent via the API extracts vendor, jurisdiction (Malta), data scope, etc.
Probable root cause: webapp/src/pages/AssessmentWorkspace.jsx ExtractionTab posts documentText: attachment.fileName.
Suggested fix: Let the API load change_request_attachment.extracted_text by attachmentId (drop documentText from the client contract).

Title: Correcting an extracted field from the UI always fails
Expected: Correction saved; original AI value retained in the audit trail.
Actual: Clicking Correct shows "Failed to correct extracted field." (HTTP 500); the field keeps its AI value. The same correction through the API with an actorUserId succeeds (TC-API-051).
Probable root cause: ExtractionTab.correct() in AssessmentWorkspace.jsx omits actorUserId from input, so Guid.Empty is written and fails the actor foreign key.
Suggested fix: Send currentUser.id (better: take the actor from the token server-side, see DEF-002) and map the FK failure to 400.

Title: Scoring-config changes apply to in-flight assessments
Expected: In-flight assessments keep the configuration version in force when they started unless explicitly re-run.
Actual: An assessment opened while the cap was 0.85 was scored with 0.80 immediately after the cap was changed.
Probable root cause: func_calculateAndSaveRiskScore reads the currently active scoring_config instead of the version pinned on the assessment (fk_assessment_scoring_config_version exists but is unused).
Suggested fix: Pin the config version at OpenWorkspace and read that version during calculation.

Title: Committee vote panel does not show the assessment being voted on
Expected: Full read-only assessment (narrative, scores, cited policy, analyst overrides) visible before voting.
Actual: The Review panel shows only request number/title, the vote form and the vote list - no narrative, scores, cited policy or override history.
Probable root cause: CommitteeQueue.jsx VotePanel renders no assessment content.
Suggested fix: Render a read-only assessment summary (reuse the workspace data endpoints) above the vote form.

Title: Upload type check trusts the client Content-Type; rejections return 500
Expected: Type validated by extension + magic bytes; clear 400 "Allowed: PDF, DOCX, XLSX".
Actual: malicious.exe uploaded as application/pdf is accepted (200). .txt and .exe with their real types return 500 "Failed to attach document." instead of a clear 400 naming the allowed formats; the UI shows the same generic toast.
Probable root cause: ChangeRequestService checks only the supplied Content-Type; its InvalidOperationException is not caught by the controller.
Suggested fix: Sniff file signatures, check extension, and map validation exceptions to 400.

Title: Validation failures surface as HTTP 500 with a generic message
Expected: 400 with a message saying what is wrong.
Actual: Unknown/empty change type, reliance decision "Maybe", inherent 0/6 or effectiveness 1.5/-0.2, workflow value "{not json", blank scoring-config reason and unsupported uploads all return 500 "Failed to ...". The UI then shows e.g. "Failed to calculate risk score."
Probable root cause: BaseApiController only converts service-level InvalidOperationExceptions caught in specific controllers; PostgresException from CHECK/RAISE bubbles to the generic 500.
Suggested fix: Validate inputs in the services (or FluentValidation) and map PostgresException 23514/P0001 to 400 centrally.
Linked tests: TC-API-013 (failed) TC-API-014 (failed) TC-API-042 (failed) TC-API-101 (failed) TC-API-103 (failed) TC-UI-042 (failed)

Title: No server-side validation of mandatory fields or field length
Expected: 400 listing the missing fields; bounded lengths.
Actual: A request with empty title and description is created (200, new CR number); a 20,000-character title is accepted.
Probable root cause: SubmitChangeRequestInput has no validation; only the SPA checks.
Suggested fix: Add [Required]/[MaxLength] or explicit checks in ChangeRequestService.

Title: Relying on the same passage for a second category discards the decision
Expected: One reliance row per (assessment, category, passage).
Actual: RecordReliance for chunk X under Customers & Entities then Delivery Channels returns the SAME id; only the first category keeps the row, so the second category still shows "No policy reviewed".
Probable root cause: func_recordPolicyReliance ON CONFLICT (assessment_id, policy_chunk_id) - risk_category_id is not in the key.
Suggested fix: Include risk_category_id in the unique key.

Title: AI category proposal is inconsistent - Vendor onboarding sometimes omits Delivery Channels
Expected: Vendor onboarding -> Customers & Entities + Delivery Channels (the documented primary mapping).
Actual: Across runs the same kind of Vendor request was mapped to Customers & Entities only (API lifecycle, 3 of 3 runs) and to Customers & Entities + Delivery Channels (UI, final run). The primary mapping is left to the model.
Probable root cause: The deterministic change-type -> category baseline is not enforced; the proposal is left entirely to the model.
Suggested fix: Seed the primary categories deterministically and let the model add/justify extras (and add an eval case).

Title: Controls library is empty, so credited controls cannot be traced
Expected: A seeded controls library per category with configured mitigation weights, selectable in the Scoring tab.
Actual: GET /Scoring/Controls/{id} returns 0 controls for all four categories; the UI always sends controlIdsCredited: [].
Probable root cause: No seed data for controls; no control picker in the UI.
Suggested fix: Seed synthetic controls and add a multi-select to ScoringTab.

Title: Requester sees "Decisioned" only - no decision, conditions or notifications
Expected: Request status Approved / Rejected / Deferred / Approved-with-Conditions with the conditions attached; PO notified.
Actual: After an Approved-with-Conditions decision, My Requests shows status "Decisioned"; the outcome and conditions are not visible to the Product Owner and no notification exists.
Probable root cause: change_request.status is set to the generic Decisioned; MyRequests.jsx has no decision view; notifications not implemented.
Suggested fix: Store the resolution on the request, show it (with conditions) on My Requests, add in-app notifications.

Title: No structured type-specific fields per change type
Expected: Structured, mandatory fields per change type.
Actual: Vendor and Geography show the same single free-text "Type-specific details" box; no vendor name / jurisdiction / data-scope or target country fields.
Probable root cause: Intake.jsx renders one generic textarea.
Suggested fix: Define a per-type field schema and render/validate it (client + server).

Title: Policy results show no source link, effective date or relevance rationale
Expected: Link to the source document, version/effective date, and why it was ranked.
Actual: Each result shows section reference and passage text only, although the API returns sourceUrl and effectiveDate.
Probable root cause: PolicyTab renders only sectionRef and chunkText.
Suggested fix: Render documentTitle, sourceUrl (link), effectiveDate and rank/rationale.

Title: Extracted-field correction has no reason input
Expected: Analyst enters a reason for material corrections (mandatory), optional for formatting fixes.
Actual: The Correct button always sends reason "Analyst correction" and isMaterialChange=true; the analyst cannot state why.
Probable root cause: Hard-coded values in ExtractionTab.correct().
Suggested fix: Add a reason field and a "material change" toggle.

Title: Examiner export of the audit trail
Expected: Durable, human-readable export with before/after state per entry.
Actual: Initial run found no export control in the repository source. The deployed build does provide "Export PDF" (verified: valid PDF downloaded). On-screen entries still show action/actor/reason without before/after values.
Probable root cause: Not implemented.
Suggested fix: Add a server-side PDF/CSV export of GET /Audit/{id} including before/after JSON.

Title: Policy corpus has 5 passages - most core FFIEC topics return nothing
Expected: A corpus covering the FFIEC / FATF sections the four categories cite.
Actual: Only 5 passages exist in total; wire transfer, correspondent banking, PEP, sanctions, MSB and other core topics return no match.
Probable root cause: Seed corpus is a placeholder.
Suggested fix: Ingest the FFIEC BSA/AML manual sections + FATF lists (chunk + index) as planned.

Title: Missing security headers; server banner disclosed
Expected: Standard hardening headers present; banner removed.
Actual: No Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options or Referrer-Policy; "Server: Kestrel".
Probable root cause: No header middleware; Kestrel AddServerHeader default.
Suggested fix: Add a security-headers middleware and KestrelServerOptions.AddServerHeader = false.

Title: WCAG 2.1 AA violations on most screens (see axe evidence per screen)
Expected: No critical/serious violations.
Actual: axe-core: button-name [critical] on every signed-in screen (icon-only buttons such as the mobile menu / sidebar close and the select triggers have no accessible name); label [critical] x4 on Configuration (Rule key, Reason, Value, Category not associated); color-contrast [serious] x7 in the workspace (muted text); scrollable-region-focusable [serious] on My Requests.
Probable root cause: See evidence - typically colour contrast and form controls without programmatic labels (<Label> without htmlFor on selects/inputs).
Suggested fix: Associate labels (htmlFor/aria-labelledby), fix contrast tokens, add accessible names.
Linked tests: TC-A11Y-002 (failed) TC-A11Y-003 (failed) TC-A11Y-004 (failed) TC-A11Y-005 (failed) TC-A11Y-006 (failed) TC-A11Y-007 (failed)

Title: Overridden score still attributed to "System"
Expected: scoredBy = "Analyst" (and the analyst id) for overrides.
Actual: After an analyst override the score row has isOverride=true but scoredBy="System".
Probable root cause: func_overrideRiskScore does not update scored_by.
Suggested fix: Set scored_by = 'Analyst' in the override function.

Title: Database error codes leak into user-facing messages
Expected: Clean domain message without PostgreSQL SQLSTATE codes.
Actual: e.g. "P0001: A reason is required to edit an AI-drafted narrative section".
Probable root cause: PostgresException.Message passed through.
Suggested fix: Use PostgresException.MessageText or map to domain messages.

Title: Missing-field message does not list which fields are missing
Expected: Message / inline errors naming only the missing fields.
Actual: Always "Change type, title, and description are required." even when only one is missing; no inline field errors.
Probable root cause: Single static toast in Intake.jsx.
Suggested fix: Compute the missing list; add aria-invalid + inline messages.

Title: Unpaginated request list is slow; large JS bundle
Expected: p95 < 1.5 s for reads; paged lists; code-split bundle.
Actual: GET /api/ChangeRequest p95 ~2.4 s (grows with every request - no paging); DOMContentLoaded ~2.4 s; ~650 KB JS.
Probable root cause: func_getAllChangeRequests returns every row; single Vite chunk.
Suggested fix: Add paging/filters; lazy-load pages.

Title: User switcher truncates the role ("ProductOwne")
Expected: Full label or ellipsis with a tooltip.
Actual: Header switcher reads "Priya Owens — ProductOwne" at 1440 px.
Probable root cause: Fixed w-56 trigger.
Suggested fix: Widen / add truncate + title.
